text:
Gold Price in 1981
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1981, the LBMA gold price fell 21.5% between 1981-01-30 ($507) and 1981-12-30 ($398). The highest sampled price was $514 in March and the lowest was $398 in December. The mean of these observations was $450. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
